description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Notification under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018, Luxury Tax on Motor Vehicles
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the amendment of tax regulations (Luxury Tax on Motor Vehicles) under the Finance Act, No. 35 of 2018. It contains legal/regulatory content about modifying statutory instruments and compliance requirements, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5). While it mentions a minister's name and title, the primary content is regulatory amendment rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments.
